# Wine headers and data

Files copied unchanged from Wine (<https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine>, mirrored at <https://github.com/wine-mirror/wine>) at
commit `0738d528db522f52d9d75f2aec712688dd31d1d2` (2026-10-28). Wine is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License,
version 2.1 or later: see `COPYING.LIB` and `LICENSE`. `AUTHORS` is Wine's list of contributors.

- `include/`: the Windows API headers of Wine's `include/` directory that the ported ntdll sources in `src/ntdll/rtl` need:
  `windef.h`, `winnt.h`, `winternl.h`, `ntstatus.h`, `winerror.h`, `ddk/wdm.h`, the event tracing headers and the headers
  those include. They are not edited. A few headers of the mingw-w64 project that Wine carries (`sal.h`, `specstrings.h`,
  `concurrencysal.h`, `driverspecs.h`) keep their own notices.

Nothing else of Wine is vendored. The ported source files live in `src/ntdll/rtl/` with their upstream copyright headers, and
every change to one is marked `ntpers:`. `docs/policy/THIRD-PARTY.md` lists each file and what was taken from where.

The NLS tables in `src/ntdll/rtl/nls_tables.h` are generated by `build/gen_nls_tables.py` from the `nls/` directory of the same
Wine commit.
